strings.i-a1.prompt: Which colour is the sky on a clear day? (i-a1)
strings.i-a1.explanation: Blue is the answer: it is what the course teaches here.
strings.i-a1.o.w1.why: Green is a common mix-up, but it is not what the question asks for.
strings.i-a1.o.w2.why: Red is the colour of a sunset, not of a clear sky at noon.
strings.i-a2.prompt: The sky is blue on a clear day. (i-a2)
strings.i-a2.explanation: The sky looks blue because air scatters blue light most.
strings.i-a2.why: Think of a clear noon sky: it is blue.
